name: Chupi Chupi Otoko no Ko ~Katei Kyoushi to Futago no Himitsu no Jugyou~
original_name: ちゅぴちゅぴ男の娘 ～家庭教師と双子のひみつの授業～
source: Keiichi is a college student who was asked to look after and tutor two twin sisters. He shortly finds out that sisters were actual traps. And despite having opposite personalities they will both tempt Keiichi any chance they get.
